pages.title: Frame Step
pages.text: Afterimage Moon only. Three timed dashes: 2, 3 and 4 blocks.

Press $(k:ecmoons.moon_ability) to dash $(l)2 blocks$() the way your movement keys point (or where you look). When the step ends, a short window opens (about a quarter of a second): press again for $(l)3 blocks$(), then again for $(l)4 blocks$(). Each step can turn up to 45 degrees.
pages.title: How it works

pages.text: $(l)Too early$() (while still moving, or before the window): the sequence breaks and you're slowed by 40% for half a second.$(br2)Miss the window and the sequence simply ends.$(br2)After the third step, your next melee hit within 1 second has $(l)+60% knockback$(), once.

$(l)Cooldown:$() 8 seconds, starting when the sequence ends.$(br2)$(l)Limits:$() steps stop at walls, doors, ceilings and the world border; you never pass through blocks. No dashing while flying, gliding, swimming or riding. There's no invulnerability and fall damage is normal.$(br2)$(l)Counterplay:$() back away after the third step; the bonus only lasts a second.
